description: Quality thresholds and the publication gate. Rules are matched in order (first match wins, fnmatch patterns). A blocking rule whose metric fails or cannot be measured blocks publication. A rule no check produced a metric for is reported as not measured. See docs/10-quality-gate.md.

rules.why: scripts/check_data_integrity.py is the existing CI gate; it includes the reporting-population and dashboard-total reconciliation (integrity.reporting-population, integrity.dashboard-totals-reconcile). A wrong published total is worse than no page.

Labels are ground truth. A database that contradicts known outcomes is publishing events known to be junk or splitting known incidents. Two are tolerated for a disputed label awaiting review; more means a cleaning step regressed or was not run.
Per-label-set breakdown of labels.contradictions_total.
Labels whose item no longer exists or whose merge cannot be followed; the regression check has no power over them.

Fixed cases for the deterministic merge rule, records-affected validation, fact recomputation and date provenance. A wrong answer means the code (or a library under it) changed behaviour the published numbers rely on.
A future-dated incident belongs to no reporting period and silently disappears from every chart and export.
A date that is not YYYY-MM-DD falls outside every half-open period query, so the incident vanishes from time-based charts.
Dates before 1990 are extraction errors; reported for repair (not charted, as the dashboard starts in 2020).
Undated incidents are counted but cannot be charted; `dedup_admin.py redate` recovers most.
Month-only placeholders make reporting lag look like repeat attacks. 35% on 2026-10-27; growth beyond 40% means new data is arriving with weaker dates.
Trend only.

The ASD risk matrix is published from stored classifications. The pipeline classifies before the dashboard phase, so more than 5% stale means classification was skipped or failed and the matrix describes events as they no longer are.
Count behind staleness.asd_stale_share.
Included in staleness.asd_stale; measurable on schemas without fingerprints.
Victim roles decided for a different membership; run `dedup_admin.py classify-entities --stale-only`.
Trend only.
Facts (records affected, type) computed for a different membership; refreshed by the next deduplication.

The recurrence analysis's 0-90 day band rests on a handful of repeats (4 on 2026-10-02); short-gap same-victim pairs are where reporting-lag duplicates concentrate. Above 10 the band is likely inflated by duplicates - run check-duplicates before trusting it.
Identical titles on two active events are usually one incident (or a generic title that identifies nothing).
One record counted as evidence for two active events double counts it.
Trend only.

Unprocessed records older than 30 days are retries that keep failing.

processing_error values that are not filter rejections are unexplained failures.
Each quarantined enrichment needs a decision: fix and release, or accept the gap.
Trend only.
A month in which a monthly source delivered nothing, or under half its trailing median, is a collection gap.
A sharp fall in a source's events by event month is either a collection gap or reporting lag in recent months.
